subject.title: feat: clarify publisher discovery state labels

question: Should publisher profiles expose “Official publisher”, “Public profile”, and “Public catalog” as the approved present-day discovery vocabulary before the separate feed and trust-state work lands?
rationale: The patch deliberately defines product language for identity and discovery facts; source-level correctness cannot determine whether these labels are the intended durable UX contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow fact-only labels
options.body: Keep the PR scoped to currently available publisher facts and land it after rebase and real browser proof.

options.title: Narrow or defer the vocabulary
options.body: Ask for revised labels or defer the profile-state row until the broader publisher-feed/discovery direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow fact-only labels
recommendation.body: Keep the PR scoped to currently available publisher facts and land it after rebase and real browser proof.
